Actual final service documents and exported complete Canvas inputs are checked. Labels and timestamps do not certify participant identity, browser provenance or hidden history implementation.

notes: 36+3 reports artifact coverage; human, aesthetic, font, physical-size and performance gates remain open.
The correction binds existing actual service SVG exports by exact saved Canvas; it does not establish a new browser download-link observation.
The prior strict report remains failed and the prior 39-image matrix remains historical.

limitations: This audit checks fields and hashes; screenshot pixel content requires separate review.
The export copy correction preserves screenshot time/DOM and bytes, but does not prove timestamp provenance or a causal browser request.
Unique resolution filters format SVG; one same-Canvas export also has a PDF, so complete-document equality across all formats is not globally unique.
Live source/core/build were checked before and after this audit. The collector alone does not attest that they stayed frozen concurrently.
Annotation body checks cover leaf/other-note rectangles, excluding edge routing, markers, frame headers and actual host glyph shapes.
CNN note text wraps skip path into skip p / ath.; exact source/DOM consistency does not approve that typography.

Three browser-observation heightMm values differ from the source SVG metadata by at most5.69e-14. Only this numeric field uses1e-9 serialization tolerance; all other metadata fields and independently rebuilt SVG XML are exact. No input bytes were altered.
